summary: A tribute to Jon, delivered at UCLA on October 30, 1998, in memory of Jon Postel by his longtime colleague Danny Cohen. It recalls their years working together on Internet projects at ISI. It is a personal memorial, not a technical specification.

eli5.summary: This is a speech about a good friend and coworker who had died, remembering what it was like to work with him every day.
